the morphology of the siloxane urethanes is determined by the conditions of synthesis, the nature of the diol, the nature of siloxane, and the molar ratio of the diol to siloxane.

the morphology of the copolymers strongly depends on the conditions of the synthesis, especially the reaction temperature.

the morphology of the siloxane urethanes can be controlled by varying the reaction conditions.
